rationale.conceptual: The method involves established DFT/DFPT techniques but requires careful implementation of strain-energy elastic constants, phonon dispersion calculations with proper convergence, and quasiharmonic free-energy integration; while not novel, it is a multi-part documented algorithm that demands domain understanding.
rationale.execution: The reproduction involves multiple sequential stages: static energy scans, EOS fitting, elastic constant calculations on strained cells, DFPT phonon calculations at several volumes, free-energy construction, and thermodynamic property derivation. Orchestrating Quantum ESPRESSO runs for many configurations, parsing outputs, and ensuring convergence across all steps makes the pipeline long and fragile.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires implementing a multi-stage DFT-based workflow for elastic and thermodynamic properties of bcc W, involving careful parameter selection, EOS fitting, strain-based elastic constants, DFPT phonon calculations, and QHA free-energy integration; while the method is well-established, the pipeline is lengthy and fragile, making it moderately difficult conceptually and executionally.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT plane-wave calculations with 60 Ry cutoff, moderate k-point grids (14×14×14), and phonon q-grids (8×8×8); CPU-only, typical cluster job with modest memory (~16 GB) and negligible input data.
